nodes.title: DamID
nodes.scope: Two-arm Illumina explanatory DamID schematic: in vivo adenine marking by a Dam–protein-of-interest fusion versus unfused Dam, followed separately by DpnI digestion, adapter ligation, DpnII digestion and selective PCR, then sequencing and comparison of mapped DNA. DamID-Seq names the sequencing readout implementation of DamID. The schematic is not a full library-construction recipe. Named Inducible DamID and NeuroDam variants in related abstracts are annotated for scope only; their unshown workflows are not merged into this graph. No origin date is assigned from the catalogue or publication dates.
